limitations: Single-user alpha: original ArtCraft UI previews can be registered separately; original UI/server processing and provider parity are pending.
RapidRAW is not bundled: its independent Linux installation remains a separate CLI workflow.

FilmCraft and the bounded DesignCraft PAR-03 bridge are separate Actions-built browser preview archives. DesignCraft routes allowlisted file.new, frame.create, edit.undo and edit.redo actions to its owned server worker and refreshes the revisioned read model/render over the original UI shell; the owned worker also returns a canonical Document snapshot capped at 16 MiB. The original DesignApp candidate supports bounded A4, Rectangle Tool and Undo/Redo workflows only; remaining actions/tools, provider/save ACK and recovery remain pending. These are not complete server-backed original-app bundles.
The native laptop mount helper is not bundled. Use upload or copy-first mode; on-demand/hybrid mounts require a separately installed and verified helper.
CI smoke tests use generated documents; real browser folder permissions and broad format compatibility require separate acceptance.
Linux requires glibc 2.35+; Windows requires the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 runtime; macOS bundle targets Apple Silicon on macOS 14+.
This release stays draft until original-UI asset packaging and target/browser acceptance evidence are complete; it is not a complete creative suite.

DesignCraft alpha.37 CI verifies original file.new and Type Tool ACKs through the owned worker, plus a bounded Open/edit/Undo/Save a Copy candidate for server and laptop destinations. The provider browser uses a mocked File System Access folder handle, so real permission, uncertain-output recovery, remaining actions/tools and full original parity are pending. Keep this candidate draft-only and the catalog planned. See docs/evidence/creative-workspace-alpha37-release.md.
